# vappcloud_iam_policy_version (Resource)

An immutable version of a customer-managed IAM policy. A policy may retain at most five versions.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "vappcloud_iam_policy_version" "candidate" {
  policy_id      = vappcloud_iam_policy.readonly_vmm.id
  set_as_default = false
  document = jsonencode({
    Version = "2026-08-01"
    Statement = [{
      Effect   = "Allow"
      Action   = ["vmm:Get", "vmm:List", "vmm:Metrics"]
      Resource = "*"
    }]
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `document` (String) IAM policy JSON using Version `2026-08-01`. Changing it replaces this immutable version.
- `policy_id` (String) Owning customer-managed policy ID.

### Optional

- `set_as_default` (Boolean) Promote this version on create or update. Setting false does not demote an active version; promote another version first.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) Version creation timestamp in RFC3339 format.
- `id` (String) Opaque public resource identifier.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is currently the policy default.
- `version` (String) Server-assigned immutable version such as `v2`.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import vappcloud_iam_policy_version.candidate policy-id/v2
```
